subject: Post-signup incentive credit plan & workshop follow-up
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-signup incentive credit plan & workshop follow-up

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Quick note following the BrightBridge partnership thread: they want a straightforward incentive for workshop registrants to convert to the hosted API. Proposal below — I wanted to get sign-off before we provision codes.

Proposal:
- Pool: 1,200 single-use promo codes
- Value: $40 account credit per code (applies to token usage; not combinable with other offers)
- Eligibility: registrants who sign up within 7 days of the workshop
- Trial extension: optional +14 days on top of existing trial (opt-in for account owners)
- Reporting: BrightBridge wants daily redemptions CSV and a weekly summary (counts + $ applied)

Attachments: promo_budget.xlsx (high-level P&L; includes expected conversion scenarios).

Ask:
1) Marissa — can you approve the $40 per-account limit and the 1,200 pool?
2) Ben — if yes, can your team generate the code_pool.csv (single-use codes, redeemable via signup only) and a delivery ETA?
3) Also want language approval for the partner email (short copy included below).

Partner email draft (subject / first line):
Subject: Thanks for joining the workshop — here’s a $40 Redwood credit
Body first line: Thanks for attending the BrightBridge workshop. Use this one-time code for $40 credit toward your Redwood trial — redeem within 7 days.

Happy to sync if easier — 15 min should do.

Thanks,
Alex
Senior Sales Associate
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signup incentive credit plan & workshop follow-up

Thanks Alex — this looks reasonable. A couple of quick edits from a GTM perspective:

- Approve pool size of 1,200 and $40 cap per account.
- Please make the trial extension opt-in via code redemption (so we don't auto-extend everyone).
- Request: cap redemptions to 3 codes per company domain to limit partner self-redemption (we can relax after initial week).
- Reporting: BrightBridge will need the daily CSV; Ben, can your team add a column for "account_domain" so we can easily filter duplicates?

I like the partner copy — small wording tweak: replace "redeem within 7 days" with "activate within 7 days of receiving the code" (makes it clearer for delayed emails).

Alex — please loop in Jane at BrightBridge with the final ETA for codes and a sample of the CSV layout. Ben — if you can provision a test batch (20 codes) by tomorrow EOD that we can hand to the partner, that'd be ideal.

Marissa
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

On Oct 19, 2026, at 9:12 AM, Alex Martinez wrote:
> Quick note following the BrightBridge partnership thread: they want a straightforward incentive for workshop registrants...

From: Jane Park <jane@brightbridge.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: registration@brightbridge.com
Date: 2026-10-19T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signup incentive credit plan & workshop follow-up

Hi Alex / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround. This aligns with what we had in mind. A few implementation questions from our side: 

1) Code format — do you have a recommended template? (e.g., RBW-XXXX-YYYY)
2) Can the redemption be restricted to new accounts only? We want to avoid existing customers applying credits.
3) Reporting cadence — daily CSV is perfect; do you have a preferred SFTP or would an email attachment to registration@brightbridge.com suffice for the first week?

We can take the 20-code test batch and use it in a small RSVP confirmation email to validate flow. If everything looks good, we'll send the bulk registrant list (we can provide a feed) and request codes be tied to emails at time of redemption.

Also — please include a sample of the CSV layout so our ops team knows where to pull reconciliation fields.

Thanks,
Jane Park
Partnerships Manager
BrightBridge Events

On Oct 19, 2026, at 10:05 AM, Marissa Cole wrote:
> Thanks Alex — this looks reasonable. A couple of quick edits from a GTM perspective...

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Park <jane@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, registration@brightbridge.com
Date: 2026-10-20T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signup incentive credit plan & workshop follow-up

Hi Jane — great questions. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Code format: we'll use RBW- followed by an 8-character alphanumeric string (example: RBW-4F7K-91Q2). I've asked Ben to generate the full pool in code_pool.csv and include a sample column layout.
2) Redemption restriction: yes — codes will only be redeemable on new accounts (we'll validate by signup timestamp and account creation). Existing accounts will get an error message during redemption.
3) Delivery method: for the pilot we'll send the daily CSV to registration@brightbridge.com as an email attachment (SFTP is an option for scale; we can revisit after the pilot).

Ben — can you confirm the test batch (20 codes) is ready by EOD today and share the CSV sample (columns: code, issued_at, redeemed_at, account_email, account_domain, credited_amount)? Also apply the 3-codes-per-domain guard Marissa requested.

Jane — once Ben confirms, we'll send the 20 codes and the partner email copy (with the wording tweak: "activate within 7 days of receiving the code"). If pilot looks clean, we can deliver the bulk pool within 48 hours of sign-off.

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn.

Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Associate
Redwood Inference

Attachments: code_pool.csv (to be generated; will include sample-rows column in next message)
